scenes.title: Nikita's Proposal
scenes.summary: Nikita asks Katya to marry him, and Kostya convinces a worried Denis that Katya still has feelings for him.

scenes.title: Denis's Clever Plan
scenes.summary: Denis decides to tell Katya he is leaving town forever to test her reaction, while Chef Barinov plots revenge on Mikhail.

scenes.title: Little Styopa's Drawing
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov plans a prank with Senya in the kitchen, while Nastya and Kostya examine a suspicious drawing by their son.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Past
scenes.summary: Kostya is shocked to learn his father served time in prison for card sharping on trains in the nineties.

scenes.title: News for Katya
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov's prank backfires on Eleonora, and Denis tells Katya that he is moving back to Voronezh tomorrow.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Firing
scenes.summary: The kitchen staff overhears Denis's fake departure announcement, and Mikhail promptly fires him on the spot.

scenes.title: The Room and the Bar
scenes.summary: Mikhail looks for a new pianist, Ainura asks Kostya to rent his spare room, and Chef Barinov orders whiskey at the bar.

scenes.title: Kostya's Father at the Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya's father tries to apologize at the bar, and after Kostya brushes him off, he confides in Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: A Card Player's Talent
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov learns about Timofey's card skills and realizes he can use him in Mikhail's high-stakes poker game.

scenes.title: Plan B and the Suit
scenes.summary: Denis panics over being fired, Kostya devises a backup plan, and Chef Barinov dresses Timofey in a fancy suit.

scenes.title: The Game Begins
scenes.summary: Timofey convinces Mikhail to let him into the private poker game, and Chef Barinov sneaks in to watch.

scenes.title: Money for the Farewell Party
scenes.summary: Denis tries to talk to Katya alone in the hallway, but Nikita and Senya interrupt to announce a farewell party.

scenes.title: A High Bet
scenes.summary: Timofey goes all-in with a straight at the poker table, but his opponent beats him with a flush and takes all the money.

scenes.title: A Toast to Denis
scenes.summary: The kitchen staff toasts Denis at his farewell party while Kostya advises him to announce that he decided to stay.

scenes.title: Kostya's Speech and All-In
scenes.summary: Kostya gives a funny speech about losing Denis's rent money, while Chef Barinov joins the poker game and goes all-in.

scenes.title: The Loss and Threats
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov loses the massive poker hand to a higher full house and gets locked up when he cannot pay his debt.

scenes.title: Confession on the Roof
scenes.summary: Mikhail celebrates his successful poker prank on Chef Barinov, while Denis confesses his love to Katya and she kisses him.

scenes.title: Katya Says Yes
scenes.summary: Fleeing her feelings for Denis, Katya accepts Nikita's marriage proposal, and Nikita joyfully announces it to the restaurant.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Advice and Payback
scenes.summary: Eleonora advises Kostya to forgive his father before time runs out, while Chef Barinov gets terrified by Mikhail's staged gangster.

scenes.title: Reconciliation with Father
scenes.summary: Kostya forgives his father and brings him home, while Denis is stunned to learn that Katya accepted Nikita's proposal.
